representation.shell_command:

import sys
p=sys.argv[1]
with open(p) as f, open('left.bed','w') as l, open('right.bed','w') as r:
    for line in f:
        if not line.strip() or line.startswith('#'): continue
        x=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        try: s=int(x[1]); e=int(x[2])
        except: continue
        if s>=25:
            l.write(f'{x[0]}\\t{s-25}\\t{s+25}\\n')
        if e>=25:
            r.write(f'{x[0]}\\t{e-25}\\t{e+25}\\n')
PY

representation.name: Locate Tn5 bias axis in centered endpoint windows
representation.shell_command:
python - "$(inputs.fasta.path)" <<'PY'
import sys,math
B='ACGT'; comp={'A':'T','C':'G','G':'C','T':'A'}; K=50
C=[[0]*4 for _ in range(K)]; N=[0]*K; seq=''; nseq=0

def add(s):
 global nseq
 s=s.upper()
 if len(s)!=K:return
 # right endpoint: reverse-complement to face inward
 s=''.join(comp.get(x,'N') for x in reversed(s))
 nseq+=1
 for i,x in enumerate(s):
  if x in B:C[i][B.index(x)]+=1;N[i]+=1
with open(sys.argv[1]) as f:
 for line in f:
  line=line.strip()
  if line.startswith('>'):
   if seq:add(seq)
   seq=''
  else:seq+=line
if seq:add(seq)
P=[[(x+.5)/(n+2) for x in row] for row,n in zip(C,N)]
bgc=[sum(C[i][b] for i in range(K)) for b in range(4)]; z=sum(bgc); bg=[x/z for x in bgc]
def ic(row):return sum(p*math.log(p/bg[b],2) for b,p in enumerate(row))
with open('axis.txt','w') as o:
 o.write(f'n={nseq} bg='+' '.join(f'{B[b]}:{bg[b]:.6f}' for b in range(4))+'\\n')
 o.write('axis correlation signal mse pairs\\n')
 scores=[]
 for a2 in range(30,71):
  dot=xx=yy=mse=sig=0.; np=0
  for i in range(K):
   j=a2-i
   if 0<=j<K and i<j and abs(i-a2/2)<=12:
    np+=1
    for b in range(4):
     x=P[i][b]-bg[b]; y=P[j][3-b]-bg[3-b]
     dot+=x*y;xx+=x*x;yy+=y*y;mse+=(x-y)*(x-y)
    sig+=ic(P[i])+ic(P[j])
  corr=dot/(xx*yy)**.5 if xx and yy else 0
  scores.append((corr,sig,-mse,a2/2,np,mse))
 for corr,sig,neg,axis,np,mse in sorted(scores,reverse=True):
  o.write(f'{axis:.1f} {corr:.8f} {sig:.6f} {mse:.8f} {np}\\n')
 o.write('PWM pos A C G T IC\\n')
 for i,row in enumerate(P):o.write(f'{i} '+' '.join(f'{x:.6f}' for x in row)+f' {ic(row):.6f}\\n')
PY
